independentObservationsRegression.network: Separate BrowserContexts; both actual embedded role HTMLs operated with networking disabled. A temporarily reloaded online only for save testing.
independentObservationsRegression.progression: Only chapter skips prepare preceding acts. Current-act answers are obtained by reading B printed chart/catalog/film and mount table, then entered through real A dragging, wheel and physical confirmation input.
independentObservationsRegression.cooperation: A has task/equipment names and unlabelled fields, B has requested reference data and no live instrument. Each of the three tasks confirms separately and can be repeated without resetting the other two.
independentObservationsRegression.offlineLimit: Information dependency does not prove that another offline computer was actually used; prior knowledge and lucky guesses remain possible.

fifthActAndNormalContinuation.network: Separate BrowserContexts and embedded role HTML files; networking disabled during current-act operation, enabled only for explicit reload persistence checks.
fifthActAndNormalContinuation.progression: Prior history is seeded at the final Act IV checkpoint, which is completed through actual input before normal-story continuation into Act V. No current fifth-act milestone or answer is injected.
fifthActAndNormalContinuation.cooperation: The test reads B visible same-name forecast, enters A dome settings, reads A newly revealed original plate angles/rail positions, registers B plates, reads B newly revealed exposure record and enters A shutter settings. All gameplay uses real pointer, wheel, drag and held controls.
fifthActAndNormalContinuation.offlineLimit: B final stamp is a human voice-call acknowledgement, not remote-state verification. Prior knowledge and lucky guesses remain possible in an offline game.
fifthActAndNormalContinuation.artStatus: Act V instruments, original plates and ending are explicitly labelled interaction prototypes; no final art claim.
